title: Cebuana beach volley stars Rondina, Progella lead Asian Games PH charge

blocks.text: NAGOYA, Japan — Cebuana beach volleyball stars Sisi Rondina and Khylem Harl Progella helped power the Philippines into the quarterfinals of the women’s beach volleyball competition in the 2026 Asian Games on Monday, September 28. Rondina teamed up with Bernadeth Pons to dispatch Japan’s Sakura Ito and Mayu Sawame, 21-17, 21-15, in the Round of 16 at the Hekinan Ryokuchi Beach Court. Rondina is one of the Philippines’ most decorated beach volleyball players. Progella and Sofiah Shanine Pagara followed suit, overcoming Hong Kong’s N.L. Tsang and M.C.
